dedupe_keys.name: power systems test case archive university of washington including ieee bus cases and the reliability test system

description: The Power Systems Test Case Archive of the University of Washington gives web access to classic power system test cases. The page read on 2026-09-26 lists power flow cases of 14, 30, 57, 118 and 300 buses, dynamic cases of 17 generators with a 162-bus power flow, the 30-bus New England case and 50 generators with a 145-bus power flow, descriptions of the IEEE Common Data Format, PTI and PECO PSAP formats, the Reliability Test System in its 1979 and 1996 versions, programs from Wood and Wollenberg's textbook, a power system analysis data dictionary and voltage collapse sensitivities. The RTS-96 version is described in the IEEE Transactions paper linked here. Coverage is standard benchmark networks, not a real territory. Files are free to download; no licence is stated. Caveats: the archive has not been updated for many years and the old formats need conversion for modern tools, although DR POWER lists the archive among its publishing groups. Simulation uses are testing power flow, stability and reliability methods, including resilience and adequacy studies on the RTS. Related records: data-rts-gmlc is the updated version of RTS-96, and data-dr-power-egriddata-repository mirrors this archive.
